title: Reading practice: Al-Ma'un for stops and rules: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 7 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Reading practice rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 7. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ (١) فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ (٢) وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ (٣) فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ (٤) ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ (٥) ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ (٦) وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ (٧)

head: Words
Where
Rule
rows: Hamzat al-wasl: ٱلَّذِى joins without its alif

head: Not this
This
rows: Stopping at «فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ» (107:4) and moving on as if complete
It is the end of an ayah, so stopping is allowed, but explain that 107:5 completes the meaning: 'who are heedless of their prayer'

keywords.def: stopping on a word, with a breath

questions.q: Read «ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ» (107:6) and name the rules.
questions.a: هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ: izhar shafawi (meem before ي); يُرَآءُونَ: muttasil (4 or 5); 'arid at a stop on ن.

questions.q: Reading rota: each pupil reads Al-Ma'un from the mushaf to the teacher. Everyone else labels every rule in 107:1 to 7 on the pupil PDF. Today's group also recites 70:23 to 33.
questions.a: Readings marked; labels checked against the teacher sheet.

questions.q: Extend: find the madd muttasil in Al-Ma'un.
Stretch: what is 'al-ma'un' (107:7) and why is refusing it so blameworthy?
questions.a: Small acts of help such as lending everyday items; refusing even these shows a hard heart.

options: 107:5 tells us which praying people are warned
questions.a: A) 107:5 tells us which praying people are warned. Without 107:5 the warning would seem to be for everyone who prays; 107:5 makes it those heedless of their prayer.

questions.q: Think again: Al-Ma'un warns about people who pray but are heedless, show off, and refuse small kindnesses. How can a person pray and still be blamed?
questions.a: If the prayer is careless or for show, and does not make them kind to others.
